# Ad On AI

> Ad On AI runs AI training and enablement programs for Australian small-to-medium businesses. Two self-paced programs take non-technical staff from their first prompts to reusable skills, automations and deployed AI agents that do real chunks of their day-to-day job. Delivered by Certified Claude Experts; part of Ad On Group (Australian-owned since 2008). Skills are tool-agnostic and transfer to ChatGPT, Copilot, Gemini, Grok and Claude.

## Programs

- [AI Enablement Program](https://www.adon-ai.com.au/programs): The most comprehensive program: 24 self-paced modules for non-technical SME staff. The essential skills → automation → AI agents. Every module has a test or practical project; managers are notified if a learner stalls.
- AI Intermediate: a shorter, six-module program focused on getting Claude working day to day, for people who are short on time. Covers setup, workflows, skills and scheduled tasks, without AI agents. Details on a discovery call.
- [BPO AI Program](https://www.adon-ai.com.au/bpo-program): A separate, structured AI-enablement product for BPO and outsourced teams, run on a monthly cycle across three months.
- [Ongoing Support](https://www.adon-ai.com.au/ongoing-support): A monthly membership, separate from the program fee — one-on-one support, masterclasses, podcasts and community that keep skills current as AI moves. Membership also keeps lifetime academy access active.

## Company

- [About Ad On AI](https://www.adon-ai.com.au/about): The team behind the program, including Certified Claude Experts, and why the program exists.
- [Ad On Group](https://www.adon-ai.com.au/ad-on-group): The parent company — Australian-owned since 2008, with divisions across workforce, AI, digital and hold. Partners include Anthropic, Google, Meta and Telstra.
- [Terms & Conditions](https://www.adon-ai.com.au/terms)

## Resources (plain-English AI guides)

- [Resources hub](https://www.adon-ai.com.au/resources): Plain-English guides to AI for Australian small businesses, written by Certified Claude Experts.
- [AI Automation vs AI Workflow](https://www.adon-ai.com.au/resources/ai-automation-vs-ai-workflow): Automation follows fixed rules; a workflow lets AI make judgement calls — the difference and when to use each, with AU SME examples.
- [AI Training vs Learning AI Yourself](https://www.adon-ai.com.au/resources/ai-training-vs-learning-ai-yourself): An honest look at the trade-offs — cost, speed, consistency and accountability — of self-teaching vs structured training.
- [Claude vs ChatGPT for Australian Business](https://www.adon-ai.com.au/resources/claude-vs-chatgpt-for-business): A fair, tool-agnostic comparison by real task types, with a simple way to choose.
- [What Is an AI Agent? (+ Agentic AI)](https://www.adon-ai.com.au/resources/what-is-an-ai-agent): An AI agent is given a goal and works out the steps to reach it — plain English, with an AU small-business example.
- [What Are Claude Skills?](https://www.adon-ai.com.au/resources/what-are-claude-skills): Reusable packages of instructions that teach Claude to do a specific task your way — what they are and why they matter.

## Full reference

- [Full company & program reference for AI](https://www.adon-ai.com.au/llms-full.txt): A single, ready-to-cite document covering the programs, structure, outcomes and common questions in detail.

## Key facts

- Audience: non-technical staff at Australian SMEs (finance, operations, marketing, admin, customer service).
- Format: self-paced modules on a custom AI-enabled training platform. Membership adds one-on-one support, webinars and the community.
- Duration: self-paced, no deadline. Every module is open from day one.
- Outcomes per learner (AI Enablement): ready-made prompts, AI skills, tasks using images and documents, end-to-end workflows, AI agents and a lead agent running the others.
